title: Adaptive Machine Learning Models for Dynamic Environments: A Mathematical Framework for Real-Time Decision Making
content: Dynamic environments challenge traditional machine learning (ML) models due to their inability to adapt to non-stationary data distributions. This paper introduces a mathematically rigorous framework for adaptive ML models tailored for real-time decision-making in dynamic settings. Our framework integrates anomaly detection, transfer learning, and reinforcement learning (RL), leveraging statistical learning theory and optimization techniques to ensure robustness. Experimental validation demonstrates the framework’s superiority in accuracy, adaptability, and computational efficiency.
